name: vary a nonce until the hash falls below a target
mechanism: append a counter to the data and hash; if the result is not below the target, change the counter and hash again; the expected number of tries is set by the target, and anyone can verify the winning counter with one hash

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Proof-of-work algorithms' in section Computer science / Cryptography:

requires: a hash whose output is unpredictable
fails_when: the cost is pure waste by design; specialised hardware concentrates it
